gate: Gate A — Actual V3-022-R1 Gameplay Baseline Audit

visually_verified_baseline_defects.description: 2D sprites only flip horizontally (X+/X-); pure Z-depth attacks (Z+/Z-) rotate the 3D slash mesh perpendicular to the camera while the 2D character swings sideways (`DIRECTIONAL_ART_MISSING` for dedicated front/back sprites). Instant frame-0 hit check (`_check_melee_hit()` called inside `start_attack()`) triggers damage popups and hit sparks before the swing animation reaches its active strike frame.

Player (`min_dist = 1.01m`), enemies (`min_dist = 0.81m`), and Boss (`min_dist = 1.05m`) crowd into the exact same X/Z coordinates (`frame_030.png`, `frame_042.png`, `frame_050.png`). Multiple enemies stack on top of each other and the boss shield overlaps the hero's head, obscuring attack animations. Player lacks a distinct ground target ring.

visually_verified_baseline_defects.category: Trivial Enemy AI & Compressed Encounter Pacing
visually_verified_baseline_defects.description: Encounter 1 clears in 2.55s, Encounter 2 in 6.67s, Encounter 3 in 4.40s. Melee grunts (`HP=4`) have no windup warning before dealing damage (`0.08s`) and no inter-enemy spacing, allowing a single player combo + sword beam to cleave clustered enemies at once.
All 3 encounter zones share identical grey flagstone tiling, identical rear wall height, and identical lighting, differentiated only by spectral `PROCEED >>` barriers.

Boss dies in 6.50s (18.28s to 24.78s) because every player Just Parry stuns the boss for 2.0s and grants a 3x counter-attack (6 dmg + 4 sword beam dmg = 10 dmg per combo), melting 48 HP in 4 parries without the boss ever retreating, guarding frontal spam, or resetting spacing.

At 24.78s when the boss dies, `camera.max_camera_x` remains clamped at `78.0` while the player controller sees `closest_enemy == null` and calls `_steer_forward()` (`move_right`), running the player to `x = 87.20` completely off the right edge of the camera viewport! Furthermore, `clear_lbl` fades out after 2.0s while the test records until 30.82s, leaving 6 seconds of an empty stone floor with no player, no boss, and no victory UI.
